highlight.title: Lectric Labor Day e-bike sale offers up to $694 savings + price cuts, EcoFlow 4,096Wh power station $2,549 in flash sale, more
highlight.summary: LectricとEcoFlowがe-bikeとポータブル電源のセールを開催。最大694ドルの割引や、4,096Whのポータブル電源が2,549ドルで購入可能。
